builds.name: Maximum Defensive Nuke Prodigies
builds.desc: This build can be used if you want to invest into W!Lysithea in defense. For a player phase unit, a speed build helps her weapon since it relies on speed ("unit's Spd minus foe's Spd: if ≤ 9, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack; if ≥ 10, unit attacks twice"). AR-D Atk/Spd 4 is her best A slot for defense. Lull Spd/Res 3 helps her win most matchups since they will less likely be attacked. C Feud can stay as it is to help W!Lysithea to win matchups against in-combat effects such as Flayn's Caduceus Staff, one of the notable supports in offense teams. Blade Session 3 seal brings out their nuking potential. This build works the best in cavline teams.

builds.name: Arena Prodigies
builds.desc:
W!Lysithea must be at +10 to use her with this build in Arena. Since she scores low in arena, she needs a duel skill to hit the maximum scoring of 754. As a unit with an exclusive weapon, she does not need a tier 4 C passive to increase the scoring, meaning she can run C Feud 3. Since none of the skills inflicts attack debuffs, W!Lysithea can run Ruptured Sky, Aether is an alternative if you cannot access Ruptured Sky.
S/R 3 Far Trace is more preferrable than A/R Far Trace 3 to stack up speed and W!Lysithea will not be counterattacked.
As a player phase unit, W!Lysithea can run Blade Session 3 seal for an additional +9 Atk/Spd.
